description:
Hi everyone! I’m a second-year Cyber-Physical Systems Engineering student at GEC Thrissur. I’m interested in electronics, embedded systems, IoT, and robotics. I enjoy exploring new ideas, creative problem-solving, and learning through hands-on projects.

I’m looking for enthusiastic teammates with skills in programming, electronics, AI/ML, design, or robotics. More than expertise, I value creativity, teamwork, and a willingness to learn together.
